# Sage Interior Design

> Sage Interior Design is a commercial interior design firm led by founder Robyn Sherwood, specializing in space planning, 3D renderings, and sustainable design projects across British Columbia.

Based in the Okanagan region, Sage Interior Design has completed diverse commercial projects including educational facilities, corporate offices, and healthcare spaces. The firm combines professional design expertise with a focus on functional, aesthetically pleasing interiors that meet client needs.

## Project Portfolio & Case Studies

- [Affinity Optometry – Sage Interior Design](https://sageinteriordesign.ca/2022/11/06/affinity-optometry): Affinity Optometry clinic tenant improvement project in Vernon, BC
- [Private Education Facility – Sage Interior Design](https://sageinteriordesign.ca/2022/11/06/private-education-facility): K-12 school design project in North Okanagan featuring natural materials
- [UBCO Sunroom & Cafeteria – Sage Interior Design](https://sageinteriordesign.ca/2022/11/06/ubco-sunroom-cafeteria): UBCO university cafeteria renovation with acoustic solutions in Kelowna
- [Waterplay Solutions Corporate Office – Sage Interior Design](https://sageinteriordesign.ca/2022/11/06/waterplay-solutions-corporate-office): Sustainable corporate office design for Waterplay Solutions in Kelowna
- [DESC – School District 83 Education Support Center – Sage Interior Design](https://sageinteriordesign.ca/2022/11/06/desc-school-district-83-education-support-center): Education support center office design for School District 83 in Salmon Arm
